title: Sante Barley Trilogy Run Asia 2026 Iloilo Leg 3 Review: The 32K Afroman Finale
seo_title: Trilogy Run Asia Iloilo Leg 3 2026 Review | Philippines
meta_description: Sante Barley Trilogy Run Asia 2026 Iloilo Leg 3 review: August 23 at Atria Park District -- the series finale with the signature 32K Afroman distance.
dek: Set for 23 August 2026 at Atria Park District, Iloilo City, this is the culminating third leg of the Sante Barley Trilogy Run Asia series -- complete the 16K, 21K and 32K across all three legs to qualify for the 42K National Finals in Manila.
verdict: Iloilo Leg 3 closes out RunRio's three-leg Sante Barley Trilogy Run Asia series with the signature 32K 'Afroman' distance -- the longest of the trilogy -- alongside standard 5K, 10K and 21K options. The series structure is the real draw here: finishing the 16K in Leg 1, the 21K in Leg 2, and the 32K in Leg 3, in any host city, qualifies a runner for the 42K category at the National Finals in Manila, giving the whole series a progressive, goal-oriented arc rather than three disconnected races. Iloilo's race hub has moved to Atria Park District for this edition, a change worth noting for runners who ran prior legs at the old venue.

sections.heading: The Finale of a Three-Leg Series
paragraphs: Iloilo Leg 3 is the culminating race of the three-leg Sante Barley Trilogy Run Asia series, featuring the signature 32K 'Afroman' distance alongside 5K, 10K and 21K options. [1] Completing the 16K in Leg 1, the 21K in Leg 2, and the 32K in Leg 3 -- in any host city -- qualifies a runner for the 42K category at the National Finals in Manila, giving the series a clear progression rather than three standalone events.

sections.heading: A New Venue: Atria Park District
paragraphs: This edition is staged at Atria Park District, Iloilo City, a shift from previous Iloilo legs (2025), which were held at Casa De Emperador in Mandurriao. [1] Iloilo City itself -- the regional capital of Western Visayas and known historically as the 'Queen City of the South' -- is one of the Philippines' older cities, with a compact urban core well suited to a race hub. [2]

sections.heading: Awards and Race Rules
paragraphs: All finishers within the cut-off time receive a finisher's medal, with age-group and gender awards for the top 3 in the 32K category specifically for Leg 3. [1] Race rules prohibit skates, strollers or animals on course, require runners to stay within marked course boundaries, and impose a non-refundable ₱5,000 fee for formal result protests -- fairly standard RunRio-series terms.

sections.heading: No Independent Reviews Yet
paragraphs: Available research material for this leg is limited to RunRio's own official site and race calendar -- no independent participant race reports specific to this 2026 Iloilo Leg 3 were found. [1] That's not unusual for a series this structured, but runners chasing detailed course/heat feedback should treat this as an organiser-only information base for now.

sections.heading: Should You Run It?
paragraphs: If you're working toward the 42K National Finals qualification and want to close out the Trilogy series with its longest distance, Iloilo Leg 3 on 23 August 2026 is the obvious pick. Runners new to the series should note the venue change to Atria Park District and register early given the ₱5,000 protest fee and strict no-refund policy typical of RunRio events.
